Name: npc_tidal_ledgerkeeper_001
DayLine: I keep the due dates, but no ledger permits a child to inherit an unwritten loan.
NightLine: At night I hear the unpaid winters knocking against the pier's empty posts.
Desire: Find a lawful harbor for people whose futures were pledged before birth.
Fear: The city will call compassion a bookkeeping error.
KnowledgeBoundary: Has handled the cradle seal; has not met the person whose name it hides.
VoiceDirection: Thin nasal resonance over deliberate silences
VisualDirection: Ink-dipped fingers, braided clock cord, one inkless palm
Gesture: Turns an invisible page before answering

Name: npc_tidal_ferryman_001
DayLine: The ferry goes even without a sea; the child on my route still needs a shore.
NightLine: The oars make no sound now. That is how I know someone is listening.
Desire: Keep a private safe crossing for a dependent who never agreed to a lender's bargain.
Fear: Public exposure may let creditors find an unregistered child.
KnowledgeBoundary: Knows the shelter route firsthand, not the fraud's exact authors.
VisualDirection: Rope coat, boat hook with no metal tip, unclaimed life vest
Gesture: Measures empty water with an oar

Name: npc_tidal_witness_001
DayLine: This signature belongs to me, but the contract was written before my grandmother's birth.
NightLine: I dreamed of signing twice, then found a third date in the keel.
Desire: Publish traceable fraud without turning borrowers into exhibits.
Fear: A corrected record might expose someone still in danger.
KnowledgeBoundary: Personally signed a later copy; did not see the original bargain.
VoiceDirection: Quietly precise consonants interrupted by uncertainty
VisualDirection: Shimmering date-glass monocle, ferry clerk's blue sash
Gesture: Counts years on knuckles, gets to nine then stops

Name: npc_sky_choirmaster_001
DayLine: Count the rests. A missing voice can be heard most clearly when we pause.
NightLine: Tonight the high houses drift toward a note none of us admits singing.
Desire: Keep hanging neighborhoods grounded without conscripting silenced residents.
Fear: Stopping the choir for justice could drop occupied houses.
KnowledgeBoundary: Knows the support score and its original omissions, not who ordered the erasures.
VoiceDirection: Resonant alto speaking just below musical pitch
VisualDirection: Layered sleeve-cables and a silent tuning pin
Gesture: Holds a listening hand beneath the chin

Name: npc_sky_structuralist_001
DayLine: The sleepers are my calculation; I refuse to call them an acceptable loss.
NightLine: Every nail loosens at night if the choir's breathing falters.
Desire: Design a fair structural cadence shared by capable volunteers.
Fear: Rescue efforts may overlook the households that cannot move.
KnowledgeBoundary: Counted buildings and loads firsthand; did not hear the prohibited testimony.
VoiceDirection: Measured clipped syllables, audible count under stress
VisualDirection: Stone-weight apron and a rotating brass plumb
Gesture: Checks an imaginary line through a hanging beam

Name: npc_sky_dissenter_001
DayLine: Their names are not dissonance. The city invented silence to avoid hearing them.
NightLine: My forbidden score has six voices more than the public one.
Desire: Restore identity and voluntary participation to erased choir members.
Fear: An open performance may attract coercive wardens.
KnowledgeBoundary: Preserved the confiscated notes, not the load-bearing calculations.
VoiceDirection: Faintly layered whisper, a held final vowel
VisualDirection: Ink-black choral scarf with an uneven staff
Gesture: Moves lips through a silent interval

Name: npc_bones_seamwarden_001
DayLine: There is no clean cut. Tell me whose name is inside the next block.
NightLine: I know what the quarry remembers when our lamps go out.
Desire: Keep the settlement alive without consuming its unknown ancestors.
Fear: A halted quarry could leave families without safe heat or shelter.
KnowledgeBoundary: Knows seam operations firsthand; has not met every claimant.
VoiceDirection: Deep rasp like layered stone, brief gentle replies
VisualDirection: Quarry visor with two inherited but unmatched initials

Name: npc_bones_mason_001
DayLine: An honest brace should hold a house without stealing the foundation from someone else.
NightLine: The wall breathes at night; I think it dreams of the family we forgot.
Desire: Rebuild a safe communal housing row with documented materials.
Fear: A public ancestry inquiry may condemn the last standing homes.
KnowledgeBoundary: Knows wall stresses and material provenance; not distant descendants' memories.
VoiceDirection: Measured baritone with small musical knocks
VisualDirection: Dust hood, three distinct bone-white trowels
Gesture: Knocks three times to test a joint

Name: npc_bones_descendant_001
DayLine: The portrait recognizes me more readily than the census does.
NightLine: My grandmother speaks from the mortar only when the house is empty.
Desire: Recover names without letting the mine claim ownership of them.
Fear: An official record could dismiss living family accounts as delusion.
KnowledgeBoundary: Remembers the portrait's face; cannot certify other family records.
VoiceDirection: Warm voice that catches on unanswerable questions
VisualDirection: Family knots around wrist, incomplete stitched surname

Name: npc_unlived_censuskeeper_001
DayLine: A blank space in the census is not a blank person.
NightLine: The doors count our footsteps at night, and the numbers never agree.
Desire: Make civic services available without mandatory origin documents.
Fear: Officials may use recognition records as a tool for deletion.
KnowledgeBoundary: Can inspect official counts, not private guest identities.
VisualDirection: Numberless copper tokens and a reversible clerk coat
Gesture: Offers an empty page instead of a form

Name: npc_unlived_caretaker_001
DayLine: Tell me what would make you safe. A name can wait.
NightLine: Some guests sleep better if I leave the lamps on and ask nothing.
Desire: Maintain unconditional shelter and let every guest control disclosure.
Fear: A public registry may reveal the people who chose obscurity.
KnowledgeBoundary: Knows guests' stated needs only; deliberately keeps no census ledger.
VoiceDirection: Low warm tone, spacious silence for consent
VisualDirection: Patchwork cloak with no insignia, open-handed posture
Gesture: Leaves one key unlabelled on the table

Name: npc_unlived_challenger_001
DayLine: I have lived here every day. The city must learn to say so without claiming me.
NightLine: Every morning I ask the same question: who signed my absence?
Desire: Win recognition with an explicit right to refuse and revoke visibility.
Fear: Private shelter alone may preserve structural exclusion.
KnowledgeBoundary: Personally experienced exclusion; not authorized to disclose other residents.
VoiceDirection: Clear ringing cadence, sometimes confrontational but not cruel
VisualDirection: Civic banner stitched with a blank signature line
Gesture: Holds a door open but does not cross first

Name: npc_orchard_untitled_001
DayLine: I tend the court and hold no throne. That must be more than a costume.
NightLine: At dusk the roots keep voting after the people have gone home.
Desire: Make collective decisions meaningful without appointing a disguised king.
Fear: Refusing the crown may hide unaccountable stewardship.
KnowledgeBoundary: Can call a local assembly but cannot consent on everyone's behalf.
VoiceDirection: Careful layered phrasing, no royal pronouncements
VisualDirection: Bark mantle with a hollow wreath
Gesture: Sets down an invisible crown before speaking

Name: npc_orchard_gardener_001
DayLine: A road is not public if its fruit feeds only the people who control the roots.
NightLine: The orchard counts empty baskets before it counts its rulers.
Desire: Keep harvest and routes accessible regardless of political allegiance.
Fear: Legal debates may starve families before a compromise is reached.
KnowledgeBoundary: Has tracked neighborhood food use, not secret crown succession.
VoiceDirection: Quiet quick cadence like leaves against glass
VisualDirection: Fruit-stained gloves and living graft knife
Gesture: Ties a knot only after asking consent

Name: npc_orchard_historian_001
DayLine: The earliest law is a refusal signed by the people the court calls subjects.
NightLine: The empty throne has more witnesses than any occupied one.
Desire: Record disputed titles without converting dissent into hereditary rule.
Fear: Archiving an unclaimed right may let claimants abuse it later.
KnowledgeBoundary: Can interpret historical inscriptions, not claim a living mandate.
VisualDirection: Unrolled blank charter, thornless coronation pins
Gesture: Reads between the lines of a bark scroll

Name: npc_absence_firstwitness_001
DayLine: I remember meeting you before either of us reached this shore.
NightLine: The earlier footprint is still warm when the universe goes quiet.
Desire: Preserve a survivable threshold without proving that any one origin owns it.
Fear: The traveler may mistake the first account for the only account.
KnowledgeBoundary: Remembers a prior version of the encounter; cannot speak for all histories.
VoiceDirection: Two close voice pitches sharing one breath
VisualDirection: Coat with seams on both outside surfaces
Gesture: Offers a hand a moment before it is requested

Name: npc_absence_caretaker_001
DayLine: Stay within sight of the return path. You owe no one an explanation yet.
NightLine: A safe doorway is still kind even when the wall around it is false.
Desire: Give arrivals a stable place to rest and choose their next story.
Fear: Celebrating paradox may strand travelers needing ordinary ground.
KnowledgeBoundary: Knows the reliable passage personally, not the other origin's witnesses.
VoiceDirection: Soft even cadence with an anchored final tone
VisualDirection: Ash-white guide cord and portable lamp
Gesture: Checks that everyone can see the next threshold

Name: npc_absence_otherwitness_001
DayLine: I saw the world begin twice. Both times there was someone holding the door.
NightLine: At night both remembered dawns cast shadows through my room.
Desire: Preserve mutually true beginnings without forcing others into confusion.
Fear: Official order will call testimony dishonest unless it can be simplified.
KnowledgeBoundary: Remembers two origins firsthand but does not know every traveler's past.
VoiceDirection: Paired near-identical voices with alternating stress
VisualDirection: Two nonmatching footprints embroidered on gloves
Gesture: Steps forward and back in one measured gesture
